title: Erased
description: A former agent (Aaron Eckhart) of the CIA and his estranged daughter (Liana Liberato) go on the run after his employers target them for assassination.

description: A low-ranking agent (Jonathan Rhys Meyers) joins forces with a trigger-happy operative (John Travolta) to stop a terrorist attack in France.

title: The Courier
description: A courier in London discovers that one of the packages she's transporting is a bomb.

description: A former MI6 agent teams up with a Ukrainian journalist to uncover the truth behind Russian covert operations.

description: A former MI5 agent (Peter Firth) investigates the disappearance of Harry Pearce (Kit Harington) when the operative is blamed for the escape of a ruthless terrorist (Elyes Gabel).

title: The Blackening

title: Daybreakers
description: Faced with a critical blood shortage, a vampire hematologist joins forces with humans to perfect a cure for his problem.

title: Pandorum
